unit: source-defined biological system layer; rows are not automatically independent geographic replicates

rows.observed_pattern: Corrected trait matching is lower across all eight shared targets, whereas pollen receipt is lower in four and higher in four; tube morphology is shorter in three, longer in four and equal in one. Historical Campanula calibration additionally shows continuous floral-size/outcrossing erosion and a later autonomous-assurance transition.
rows.boundary: Pollen receipt is not a direct total-dependency estimate, and the historical Bombus-loss causal chain is not identified.

rows.observed_pattern: The same source-locked island study contains visitor-class single-visit reproductive outcomes and autonomous breeding treatments; effectiveness ranking is plant-specific rather than a universal visitor-guild property.
rows.boundary: No matched island-transition floral response is measured and broad visitor diversity is not a harmonized Izu FDQ estimand.

rows.observed_pattern: The two populations differ strongly in visitor richness/composition and visitation, whereas the reported self/outcross breeding-system index is similar and autogamy is negligible.
rows.boundary: The breeding index is not a recovered numeric total-dependency ratio and there is no matched single-visit effectiveness channel.

rows.observed_pattern: Open versus all-pollinator-excluded autogamy provides a direct reproductive-assurance/dependency contrast in one Cabrera population.
rows.boundary: No co-measured community functional-exposure gradient exists, so this panel cannot classify upstream-to-dependency propagation.

rows.observed_pattern: Visit legitimacy, lizard pollen carriage, exclusion response and plant-level reproduction establish strong contemporary animal-pollination function and dependency in one endemic plant.
rows.boundary: There is no island-transition functional-exposure gradient comparable to Izu and no historical response transition is identified.

rows.observed_pattern: The experiment identifies an added lizard contribution relative to insect-only pollination and contains flower-selection and breeding channels.
rows.boundary: The contrast is added lizard contribution, not total all-pollinator dependency, and the Balearic geography is already represented by Malva.

rows.observed_pattern: Visitation and raw fruit/seed fitness-treatment data coexist in four focal plants.
rows.boundary: Raw treatment-code interpretation is intentionally not promoted until source-locked, so propagation direction remains closed.

rows.observed_pattern: Eight native dryland plants show large among-plant differences in visitor depth; non-native insects account for most visits, while the article reports significant seed-set reduction under bagging for six species.
rows.boundary: Raw visitation/handling data do not establish equivalent effectiveness, and the published bagging outcomes are not reconstructed as source-native treatment rows.

rows.observed_pattern: A source-native bill-minus-flower axis shifts toward shorter-billed contemporary assemblages and predicts pollen contact/nectar robbing. In a closely overlapping lobelioid-bird field/experiment study, 43% of visits contact fertile structures and 39% rob nectar; experimental damage alters nectar replenishment while fruit and seed performance remain high.
rows.boundary: The two studies are not one tagged-individual chain, exact interaction-row overlap is not demonstrated, controlled reproductive dependency is absent, and the raw Functional Ecology CSV is source-access blocked in izu-core.

rows.observed_pattern: A frozen two-anchor signed plant-position prediction to corolla selection ran opposite to the declared negative direction: the primary cross-unit slope was positive and leave-one-unit estimates were predominantly positive.
rows.boundary: This rejects the exact frozen Dominica projection, not the existence of state dependence in general; retuning the mapping is forbidden.

rows.observed_pattern: Island populations have greater autonomous self-pollination capacity and about 1 mm longer corollas, but current visitation and pollen transfer are not lower on islands and island fruit set is not generally pollen limited.
rows.boundary: The cross-paper evidence is linked by sites/years rather than the same tagged individuals; current contrasts do not identify historical selection.

rows.observed_pattern: Island hummingbird visitation is lower at the broad clade comparison, yet autofertility is not generally higher on islands; within Antillean lineages, autonomous assurance, pollen limitation and floral/pollination-system transitions occur in different combinations.
rows.boundary: The links are assembled across studies/clades rather than one matched population, and per-visit pollen effectiveness is missing.

rows.observed_pattern: Dong Island has only the short morph, very low visitation and lower natural fruit set, while the same paper directly measures single-visit pollen deposition and controlled dependency at Yongxing.
rows.boundary: Direct effectiveness and controlled dependency are not measured on Dong, so the apparent response transition cannot be linked end-to-end.

rows.observed_pattern: The introduced honeybee is the dominant current visitor and is reported unable to reach the hidden stigma of S-morph flowers, producing S-to-L directional pollen transfer. Published same-species intermorph hand crosses set fruit at 82.4% and 82.6% in the two directions, while open fruit set is 2.8-8.9% in L morphs and 0.2-1.4% in S morphs; the 2018 field study reports L fruit set 1.7-38 times S.
rows.boundary: The classification applies only to the contemporary morph-access -> pollen-flow -> fruit-asymmetry chain. Historical replacement causation is inferred rather than experimentally identified; numeric signed mismatch, standardized single-visit effectiveness and controlled total dependency are missing.

summary.recurring_pattern: The strongest repeat is not a single downstream direction. Functional or interaction change can propagate in an access-limited case, branch, be buffered, run counterdirectionally, or remain only partially linked to reproduction depending on system and measurement layer.
summary.mechanism_hypothesis_after_matrix: Pre-existing functional position or physical access can set branch potential; local support and partner effectiveness alter realized interaction quality; a separate reproductive propagation/buffering gate determines whether these changes become fruit/seed or evolutionary responses.
summary.highest_value_missing_link: A matched independent system with source-native numeric signed functional position, standardized direct effectiveness, and controlled reproductive dependency plus terminal reproductive outcome at the same transition unit.

claim_boundary: Rows summarize source-locked evidence depth and qualitative propagation state, not a meta-analytic effect size. Biological system layers nested within one archipelago are not independent geographic replicates. A propagation classification does not itself prove historical causation, and missing links are never coded as zero effects.
